# Introduction

Figure S8A shows the Mtb lineage distribution across the SATVI TruCulture cohort.
Figure S8B shows lineage distribution stratified by treatment outcome, with pairwise
Fisher's exact test p-values (Bonferroni-adjusted) comparing the success group against
each of the other two outcome groups. Given the small sample sizes in the failure
(n = 2) and relapse (n = 4) groups, all results should be treated as descriptive.

# Load packages

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggsignif)
```

# Define file paths

```{r}
input_file <- "Input/Demographic and clinical information.xlsx"
output_s8  <- "Output/Figure_S8"

dir.create(output_s8, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

# Load data

```{r}
all_data <- read_excel(input_file, sheet = 1)

head(all_data)
dim(all_data)
```

# Lineage frequency table

```{r}
all_data %>%
  count(main_lineage) %>%
  mutate(percentage = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1))
```

# Figure S8A: Pie chart

```{r}
pie_data <- all_data %>%
  count(main_lineage) %>%
  mutate(
    percentage = n / sum(n) * 100,
    label      = paste0(main_lineage, "\n", n, " (", round(percentage, 1), "%)")
  )

pie_chart <- ggplot(pie_data, aes(x = "", y = n, fill = main_lineage)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 1) +
  coord_polar("y", start = 0) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("lineage2" = "#FF6600", "lineage4" = "#6699CC")) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = label),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    size = 5
  ) +
  labs(title = "Mtb lineage in SATVI TruCulture cohort") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title      = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14)
  )

pie_chart

ggsave(
  file.path(output_s8, "S8A_Mtb_lineage_pie_chart.png"),
  plot   = pie_chart,
  width  = 5,
  height = 6,
  units  = "in"
)
```

# Pairwise Fisher's exact tests

The success group is compared against treatment failure and confirmed relapse
separately. P-values are Bonferroni-adjusted for two simultaneous tests.

```{r}
outcome_data <- all_data%>%
  filter(Comments != "reinfection")

outcome_levels <- c("success", "treatment failure", "confirmed relapse")

lineage_table <- table(outcome_data$main_lineage, outcome_data$Comments)
print(lineage_table)

p_succ_fail    <- fisher.test(lineage_table[, c("success", "treatment failure")])$p.value
p_succ_relapse <- fisher.test(lineage_table[, c("success", "confirmed relapse")])$p.value

p_adj_fail    <- min(p_succ_fail    * 2, 1)
p_adj_relapse <- min(p_succ_relapse * 2, 1)

cat(sprintf(
  "Success vs treatment failure:  raw p = %.3f | adjusted p = %.3f\n",
  p_succ_fail, p_adj_fail
))
cat(sprintf(
  "Success vs confirmed relapse:  raw p = %.3f | adjusted p = %.3f\n",
  p_succ_relapse, p_adj_relapse
))
```

```{r}
format_p <- function(p) {
  if (p < 0.001) return("p < 0.001")
  paste0("p = ", sprintf("%.3f", p))
}

label_fail    <- format_p(p_adj_fail)
label_relapse <- format_p(p_adj_relapse)

cat(sprintf("Label for failure:  %s\n", label_fail))
cat(sprintf("Label for relapse:  %s\n", label_relapse))
```

# Prepare data for Figure S8B

```{r}
plot_data <- outcome_data %>%
  group_by(Comments, main_lineage) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Comments) %>%
  mutate(
    percentage = n / sum(n) * 100,
    label      = paste0(n, " (", round(percentage, 1), "%)")
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(Comments = factor(Comments, levels = outcome_levels))
```

# Figure S8B: Stacked bar by treatment outcome

Significance brackets are placed above the bars. The bracket for the wider
comparison (success vs confirmed relapse) is placed higher to avoid overlap.
The y-axis is expanded to accommodate both brackets.

```{r}
lineage_by_outcome <- ggplot(
    plot_data,
    aes(x = Comments, y = percentage, fill = main_lineage)
  ) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = label),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    size = 4
  ) +
  geom_signif(
    comparisons = list(
      c("success", "treatment failure"),
      c("success", "confirmed relapse")
    ),
    annotations = c(label_fail, label_relapse),
    y_position  = c(107, 117),
    tip_length  = 0.01,
    textsize    = 3.5
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("lineage2" = "#FF6600", "lineage4" = "#6699CC")) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 130)) +
  labs(
    title = "Mtb lineage by treatment outcome",
    x     = "Treatment outcome",
    y     = "Percentage (%)"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    plot.title  = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
    axis.title  = element_text(size = 12, color = "black", face = "bold")
  )

lineage_by_outcome

ggsave(
  file.path(output_s8, "S8B_Mtb_lineage_by_outcome.png"),
  plot   = lineage_by_outcome,
  width  = 6.5,
  height = 5,
  units  = "in"
)
```
